name: aspnet-core-scaffolding
title_zh: 从空目录到可演进架构，一次脚手架命令的事
tagline_zh: 新建项目最怕地基歪。它按 DDD+CQRS 分好层，写用 EF Core、读用 Dapper。
tagline_en: Stop hand-building the same layers. It scaffolds DDD+CQRS with EF Core writes, Dapper reads, Result pattern, and.
desc_en: Scaffolds and evolves production-ready ASP.NET Core applications using Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design, CQRS, in-process IDispatcher, Result pattern, SQL Server, EF Core for writes, Dapper for reads, Domain-owned interfaces, Infrastructure implementations, FluentValidation, dependency injection, and Central Package Management. Use when creating a new ASP.NET Core solution, establishing it
why_zh: 它把领域层与基础设施彻底解耦：接口归领域，实现归基础设施，再用 IDispatcher 做进程内总线。
why_en: Domain owns interfaces, infrastructure owns implementations—wired through an in-process dispatcher. You get clean seams for.
limit_zh: 只认 SQL Server + .NET 8+ 目标；不生成认证授权、不配 Docker、不写业务用例。
limit_en: SQL Server & .NET 8+ only. No auth, no Docker, no business use cases. Output is a wired skeleton—you add migrations and seed data yourself.
title_en: Scaffold a Clean Architecture ASP.NET Core solution in one.
